articles.summary: The Fogbender (Customer) integration is a way to establish two-directional communication with a customer team on Slack without using Slack Connect or creating a Shared Channel.
articles.title: Customer Communication in Slack without Slack Connect or Shared Channels

articles.summary: The Fogbender (Agent) integration is a way to monitor and respond to customer support conversations originating in email, Microsoft Teams, Shared Channels, or the in-app widget
articles.title: Using a single Slack channel to safely monitor B2B support traffic
